chunks: From him, from his father, from Hariz, from Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Verily, when Allah, the Exalted, created Adam (peace be upon him), He blew into him from His spirit, so he moved before his spirit reached the heart's sockets. Allah, the Exalted, said: 'O Adam.' He said: 'At your service and happiness.' He said: 'Look at what I have created for you from your offspring.' He looked to his right, heard, and looked to his left, heard. He said: 'O Lord, who are these?' He said: 'These are your offspring, these are the Prophets and the Imams.'

key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ: At your service and happiness (a response of readiness)

ai.seo_question: What did God show Adam regarding his offspring before his spirit fully entered his body?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this narration to substantiate the doctrine of *al-Nass* (explicit designation) and the pre-eternal nature of the Imams' authority within the lineage of Adam. This event underscores the theological principle that the Imamate is a divine institution established before the physical creation of humanity, reinforcing the Ahl al-Bayt's unique spiritual status as the chosen vessels of God's guidance.
